title: Slider
api:
interface SliderProps extends Omit<
  BaseSlider.Root.Props<number>,
  | 'children'
  | 'className'
  | 'value'
  | 'defaultValue'
  | 'onValueChange'
  | 'orientation'
  | 'minStepsBetweenValues'
  | 'thumbCollisionBehavior'
> {
  value?: number
  defaultValue?: number
  onValueChange?: (value: number) => void
  label?: string
  showValue?: boolean
  className?: string
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
}

function Slider({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onValueChange,
  label,
  showValue = false,
  className,
  disabled,
  id,
  size = 'md',
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  step = 1,
  'aria-label': ariaLabel,
  'aria-labelledby': labelledBy,
  'aria-describedby': describedBy,
  'aria-invalid': invalid,
  'aria-valuetext': valueText,
  ...props
}: SliderProps);
